caption: The drawing depicts a figure of a woman sitting on a chair, positioned on a square, dark-colored base. The woman has light skin, brown hair that is pulled back and draped over her right shoulder, and prominent facial features including arched eyebrows, large eyes, a straight nose, and red lips. She is wearing a long, black dress adorned with multiple horizontal rows of red, yellow, and green decorative elements. The dress features a wide, rounded neckline and covers her arms fully, with the left arm raised and bent at the elbow, and the right arm resting on her lap. Both hands are light brown in color. The woman’s shoes are black and only partially visible under the dress. The overall composition is centered on a neutral background, framed by a simple rectangular outline, with a signature "Nina Lowry" in the lower right corner outside the main image area.
title: Seated Woman
